Notice Board

Scholarship application is open to submit applications for FY 2026-27.

NSP-OTR registration is mandatory to apply for schemes of the Backward Classes welfare, Scheduled Tribe welfare & Social Welfare departments and to avail scholarship. Click here to register NSP-OTR number.

Aadhaar seeding to bank account is mandatory for submission of application and to avail scholarship. To check Aadhaar seeding status click here

To seed Aadhaar to bank account, update seeding status from one bank to another, click here (Bharat Aadhaar Seeding Enabler)

It is mandatory for Universities/ Educational Boards to publish results details in National Academic Depository (NAD) to display applications of OBC and Minority students for approval.

About Us

disbursement of Prematric & Postmatric Scholarship
under various schemes of Govt of Karnataka. SSP

and disbursal of scholarship by sponsoring
departments through DBT to the Aadhar seeded bank
account of the beneficiary.
